methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Neuromeka operates in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector and has achieved public status on KOSDAQ (ticker 277810.KQ). The company has raised $36.5M to date. The comparable universe for this stage and sector is limited: one public peer trades on KOSDAQ, while eight private robotics companies operate at various stages, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable here. Despite eight same-sector robotics peers existing in the dataset, none meet the narrow filtering criteria—same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—necessary to yield a minimum of three comparable datapoints. A broad sector median would introduce excessive noise and obscure meaningful valuation signals specific to Neuromeka's position within the robotics market.

With only one public comp and a fragmented private peer set lacking tight stage and tier alignment, this analysis is constrained by data insufficiency. A credible valuation would require either additional same-stage robotics comparables with disclosed metrics (revenue multiples, growth rates, burn profiles), deeper diligence on the single public peer's trading multiples relative to Neuromeka's fundamentals, or alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis tied to company-specific projections. The range supportable from available data is indeterminate; key uncertainties center on Neuromeka's revenue scale, profitability trajectory, and how its KOSDAQ listing price reflects underlying asset value versus market liquidity premiums.
